release_notes: Read cleaning Wheel Walk lengths as one aligned table column instead of isolated ruled cells
Trim table-border pixels without cropping right-aligned final digits
Map each OCR-observed value back to its detected row with v75 per-cell OCR only as a fallback
Remove v76/v77 automatic total-driven row reselection and simple-first OCR regressions
Keep PDF total validation fail-closed without allowing it to rewrite row lengths
Use a fresh v5 OCR cache namespace
